legend.0: Tamil is not supported, or there is no evidence at all about Tamil accuracy.
legend.1: Tamil is supported but the only evidence is on clean read speech, or the reported error rate on unscripted conversational Tamil is above 30 percent.

legend.0: No evidence of code-mixing support, or evidence that mixed speech is forced into one language or mis-transcribed.
legend.1: Code-mixed speech is handled, but English words come out transliterated into Tamil script, or the behaviour is undocumented.
legend.2: An explicit documented mode outputs Tamil words in Tamil script and English words in Latin script.

legend.0: Only suited to processing finished recordings or long files in batch.

legend.2: Supports streaming output with partial words appearing while the user is still speaking.

legend.2: Small enough (about 2.5 GB or less for its weights) to leave room for a text model and a text-to-speech model.
